name: @qodana/ci
description: Common code for Qodana Scan GitHub action and Qodana Azure Pipelines extension.

scripts.lint: npm run -w common lint && npm run -w scan lint && npm run -w vsts lint && npm run -w gitlab lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p common && tsc -p scan && tsc -p vsts && tsc -p gitlab
scripts.package: npm run -w scan package && npm run -w vsts package && npm run -w gitlab package
scripts.all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run package
